name: Moses
description: Led the Israelites out of Egypt and received the Ten Commandments on Mount Sinai
famous_quote: Let my people go

name: Abraham
description: Father of many nations, made a covenant with God
famous_quote: Here I am

name: David
description: Shepherd boy who became king, slew Goliath, and wrote many Psalms
famous_quote: The Lord is my shepherd

name: Jesus
description: The Son of God, central figure of Christianity, performed miracles and rose from the dead
famous_quote: Love your neighbor as yourself

name: Peter
description: Fisherman who became a chief apostle and leader of the early church
famous_quote: You are the Messiah, the Son of the living God

name: Paul
description: Persecutor of Christians who converted and became a major apostle, wrote many epistles
famous_quote: I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me

name: Mary
description: Virgin mother of Jesus, visited by the angel Gabriel
famous_quote: My soul magnifies the Lord

name: Noah
description: Built an ark to save his family and animals from the great flood
famous_quote: I establish my covenant with you

name: Solomon
description: Wisest king of Israel, built the first temple in Jerusalem
famous_quote: There is nothing new under the sun

name: Samson
description: Judge of Israel with supernatural strength in his hair
famous_quote: Let me die with the Philistines

name: Jonah
description: Prophet who was swallowed by a great fish after fleeing from God
famous_quote: Salvation belongs to the Lord

name: Daniel
description: Prophet who survived the lion's den and interpreted dreams
famous_quote: My God sent his angel and shut the lions' mouths

name: Esther
description: Jewish queen who saved her people from destruction in Persia
famous_quote: If I perish, I perish

name: Ruth
description: Moabite woman who showed great loyalty to her mother-in-law
famous_quote: Where you go I will go

name: Job
description: Righteous man who suffered greatly but remained faithful to God
famous_quote: The Lord gave, and the Lord has taken away

name: John the Baptist
description: Prophet who baptized Jesus and prepared the way for his ministry
famous_quote: Behold, the Lamb of God

name: Judas Iscariot
description: Apostle who betrayed Jesus for thirty pieces of silver
famous_quote: What will you give me if I deliver him to you?

name: Adam
description: First man created by God in the Garden of Eden
famous_quote: Bone of my bones and flesh of my flesh

name: Eve
description: First woman, created from Adam's rib
famous_quote: The serpent deceived me

name: Joseph
description: Son of Jacob, sold into slavery but became ruler of Egypt
famous_quote: You meant evil against me, but God meant it for good

name: Elijah
description: Prophet who called down fire from heaven and was taken up in a whirlwind
famous_quote: How long will you waver between two opinions?

name: Sarah
description: Wife of Abraham who gave birth to Isaac in her old age
famous_quote: God has made laughter for me

name: Jacob
description: Son of Isaac who wrestled with God and became Israel
famous_quote: I will not let you go unless you bless me

name: Joshua
description: Moses' successor who led Israel into the Promised Land
famous_quote: Choose this day whom you will serve

name: John
description: The beloved apostle who wrote the Gospel of John and Revelation
famous_quote: God is love

name: Matthew
description: Tax collector who became an apostle and wrote the first Gospel
famous_quote: Follow me

name: Martha
description: Friend of Jesus known for her hospitality and service
famous_quote: Lord, do you not care that my sister has left me to serve alone?

name: Mary Magdalene
description: Follower of Jesus who witnessed his crucifixion and resurrection
famous_quote: I have seen the Lord

name: Lazarus
description: Friend of Jesus who was raised from the dead after four days

name: Gideon
description: Judge who defeated the Midianites with only 300 men
famous_quote: The sword of the Lord and of Gideon

name: Deborah
description: Prophetess and judge who led Israel to victory
famous_quote: I will go with you

name: Isaiah
description: Major prophet who prophesied about the coming Messiah
famous_quote: Here am I! Send me

name: Jeremiah
description: Weeping prophet who warned of Jerusalem's destruction
famous_quote: I know the plans I have for you

name: Thomas
description: Apostle known as 'Doubting Thomas' who needed proof of Jesus' resurrection
famous_quote: My Lord and my God

name: Stephen
description: First Christian martyr, stoned to death for his faith
famous_quote: Lord, do not hold this sin against them
